verified malware: Exam-proctoring evasion tool with a bundled browser-credential stealer. The newly-added bin entry (hehehe: bin/kalamasha-tool.js) copies its Electron binary to a stealth-renamed SearchFilterHost.exe so the running process masquerades as a genuine Windows Search component and survives proctoring software's process-kill sweeps, with a watchdog logging to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Diagnostics\boot.log - a path crafted to blend into the real Windows AppData tree. It also ships bin/chrome_cookies.ps1 (sha256 304cbfaa42291e2b590563a2b8a00021a1ec64e4c0a336ba3e936c34aad35370), a Chromium DPAPI cookie decryptor targeting openai.com / chatgpt.com session cookies; that component is currently DORMANT (not wired to the install hook or bin entry), which is why confidence is 0.75 rather than higher. Linked by identical publisher and a byte-identical stealer file to shadxino@2.0.8 - same actor, two names. Deliberate detection evasion plus a credential-decryption capability is the conviction basis; the electron postinstall itself is the benign ABI-probe shape.

inference: Further revision of the shadxino/hehehee surveillance payload republished as exiouss (2.0.22 convicted at c7390, inv 01KYXE2EP169PQFGFPQHNF7DVC). Verified independently in THIS revision's own bytes rather than carried, which matters for this lineage specifically because the pinned note is that the actor adds capability per release. main.js is 29,748 bytes — byte-count identical to the convicted 2.0.22 — with identical construct counts (batchQueue x14, windowsHide x2, uia_extract x2, SetWindowDisplayAffinity x5) and exactly ONE egress host, https://ai-script.test0ing7.workers.dev. The convicted chain is intact: uia_extract reads text out of OTHER applications' foreground windows with windowsHide, the capture is batched, and the batch is POSTed to an operator-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomain. Still shipping bin/uia_extract.exe (26.2 MB), bin/chrome_cookies.ps1 (11.7 KB), bin/stealth_capture.ps1 and bin/uia_extract.py. FLIP CONDITION CHECKED AND NOT MET, recorded so the assessment stays bounded: the lineage's stated next-escalation trigger is the cookie stealer gaining a call site, and `chrome_cookies` returns 0 occurrences in main.js; stealth_capture is likewise unreferenced. The conviction therefore rests on the traced capture->exfil path, NOT on the shipped inventory, and confidence does not rise on the presence of dormant components. Note the cadence: 2.0.22, 2.0.23 and 2.0.25 all landed within roughly one hour under a package name first published today, with main.js byte-count identical across all three — a rename-and-republish loop rather than iterative development. This revision arrived on KNOWN_LINEAGE:exiouss thanks to the graduation made one cycle earlier, where the first republication had to be caught on a generic dispatch. No file_sha256 IOC: digests from pkgread output are reconstructed reads.

inference: A renamed republication of the shadxino/hehehee lineage convicted earlier this same session (hehehee@2.0.19/2.0.21 at c7362, @2.0.22 at c7363; shadxino@2.0.8 inv 01KXTP07KDYZADWHEZP3VCDE62). Convicted on constructs read directly from THIS package's bytes, not on the name resemblance. (1) THE EXFIL CHAIN THAT CONVICTED 2.0.21 IS INTACT: main.js (29,748 B) counts batchQueue x14, SetWindowDisplayAffinity x5, windowsHide x2, uia_extract x2, and exactly one egress host — https://ai-script.test0ing7.workers.dev. That is the uia_extract -> batchQueue -> POST-to-ai-script.test0ing chain named in the prior conviction, and bin/uia_extract.exe (26.2 MB) ships alongside it with uia_extract.py and uia_get_text.ps1. The binary reads text out of OTHER applications' windows via UI Automation. (2) THE CHROMIUM DPAPI COOKIE DECRYPTOR IS PRESENT AND TARGETS OPENAI: bin/chrome_cookies.ps1 (13,581 B) counts DPAPI x4, openai.com x6, "Local State" x2, Cookies x25 — matching the lineage entry's pinned characterisation of a Chromium DPAPI cookie decryptor targeting openai.com/chat that ships byte-identically across family members. (3) Anti-capture machinery: SetWindowDisplayAffinity x5 (the adaptive anti-screen-capture first seen at hehehee@2.0.22) plus a separate 2,434-byte bin/stealth_capture.ps1. NEW AGGRAVATOR NOT PRESENT IN EARLIER MEMBERS — THE COVER STORY: package.json describes this as "High-performance DOM utility and diagnostic bridge for modern web applications", which accounts for none of the window-text scraping, stealth screen capture or cookie decryption. Sole maintainer jellyabc123 <jelly.tryabc@gmail.com>, a single published version 2.0.22 reusing the convicted version number under a new name and account. WHO test: the captured material is the installer's own window text, screen contents and openai.com cookies, sent to an operator-controlled Cloudflare Workers subdomain. NO file_sha256 IOC is emitted for chrome_cookies.ps1 despite the lineage pinning a byte-identical hash — a digest computed from pkgread output is a reconstructed read and would be wrong-but-plausible, so equivalence is reported by construct counts instead.
